verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration services firm, so whether it offers the International Entrepreneur Rule parole pathway is a fair question. However, the evidence pack never mentions IER or parole, let alone qualifying-investment thresholds. Its founder-related material covers only the O-1 pathway (docs-19), and generic claims of 'a suite of visas' (docs-5) do not establish this specific pathway.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
